title: Cinematic vertical 9:16 beauty vlog style, 4k resolution, ultra-realistic…
content:
Cinematic vertical 9:16 beauty vlog style, 4k resolution, ultra-realistic textures, clean lighting, and smooth camera stabilization.
​Scene & Timeline Choreography 
​00:00 - 00:02
​Visual: A young woman with short, platinum-blonde hair and a glowing complexion looks directly into the camera with an excited expression inside a bright, modern white-tiled bathroom while holding a small yellow rubber duck under her chin.
​Voice Over: (Playful, surprised intake of breath or light chuckle)
​00:02 - 00:05
​Visual: She smiles warmly while looking down at the yellow rubber duck in her hand, then looks back up toward the camera with a playful expression.
​Voice Over: "Okay, wait..."
​00:05 - 00:07
​Visual: She brings a bottle of orange skincare serum up close to the camera, showcasing the label clearly while speaking with an enthusiastic expression.
​Voice Over: "I literally cannot believe how good this is."
​00:07 - 00:08
​Visual: A close-up shot of her hands dispensing a drop of the translucent, glossy serum onto her fingertip and rubbing it gently against her palm.
​Voice Over: (Soft ambient bathroom sounds / gentle product texture application)
​00:08 - 00:10
​Visual: Close-up of her face as she gently pats and applies the serum onto her cheek, highlighting her radiant skin and smooth application.
​Voice Over: "Look how it just melts in..."
​00:10 - 00:13
​Visual: Medium shot showing her full outfit—an off-the-shoulder white long-sleeve top, dark brown leather shorts, and white thigh-high stockings—standing by the bathroom counter with plants and a towel, gently touching her glowing cheek.
​Voice Over: "...my skin already feels insane."
​00:13 - 00:15
​Visual: She holds up the orange serum bottle again, flashing a wide, radiant smile directly at the camera while speaking excitedly.
​Voice Over: "Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"

es.content:
Estilo de beauty vlog cinematográfico vertical 9:16, resolución 4K, texturas ultrarrealistas, iluminación limpia y estabilización de cámara suave.
​Coreografía de escena y cronograma 
​00:00 - 00:02
​Visual: Una joven con el cabello corto, rubio platino y un cutis luminoso mira directamente a la cámara con una expresión emocionada dentro de un baño blanco, moderno y bien iluminado, mientras sostiene un pequeño pato de goma amarillo bajo la barbilla.
​Voice Over: (Inhalación juguetona y sorprendida o una ligera risa)
​00:02 - 00:05
​Visual: Sonríe con calidez mientras mira hacia abajo al pato de goma amarillo en su mano, luego vuelve a mirar a la cámara con una expresión juguetona.
​Voice Over: "Okay, wait..."
​00:05 - 00:07
​Visual: Acerca un frasco de sérum facial naranja a la cámara, mostrando claramente la etiqueta mientras habla con una expresión entusiasta.
​Voice Over: "I literally cannot believe how good this is."
​00:07 - 00:08
​Visual: Un primer plano de sus manos dispensando una gota del sérum translúcido y brillante sobre la yema del dedo y frotándolo suavemente contra la palma.
​Voice Over: (Sonidos ambientales suaves del baño / aplicación delicada de la textura del producto)
​00:08 - 00:10
​Visual: Primer plano de su rostro mientras da suaves toques y aplica el sérum en la mejilla, resaltando su piel radiante y la aplicación uniforme.
​Voice Over: "Look how it just melts in..."
​00:10 - 00:13
​Visual: Plano medio que muestra todo su outfit—un top blanco de manga larga y hombros descubiertos, shorts de cuero marrón oscuro y medias blancas por encima del muslo—de pie junto al lavabo del baño con plantas y una toalla, tocándose suavemente la mejilla luminosa.
​Voice Over: "...my skin already feels insane."
​00:13 - 00:15
​Visual: Vuelve a sostener el frasco naranja del sérum, mostrando una amplia y radiante sonrisa directamente a la cámara mientras habla emocionada.
​Voice Over: "Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"

fr.content:
Style vlog beauté cinématographique vertical 9:16, résolution 4K, textures ultra-réalistes, éclairage propre et stabilisation fluide de la caméra.
​Chorégraphie de la scène et du timing
​00:00 - 00:02
​Visuel : Une jeune femme aux cheveux courts, blond platine, et au teint lumineux regarde directement la caméra avec une expression enthousiaste, dans une salle de bain blanche moderne et lumineuse, tout en tenant un petit canard en caoutchouc jaune sous son menton.
​Voix off : (Inspiration amusée et surprise, ou léger rire)
​00:02 - 00:05
​Visuel : Elle sourit chaleureusement en regardant le canard en caoutchouc jaune dans sa main, puis relève les yeux vers la caméra avec une expression espiègle.
​Voix off : "Okay, wait..."
​00:05 - 00:07
​Visuel : Elle rapproche un flacon de sérum skincare orange de la caméra, en montrant clairement l’étiquette tout en parlant avec une expression enthousiaste.
​Voix off : "I literally cannot believe how good this is."
​00:07 - 00:08
​Visuel : Gros plan sur ses mains qui déposent une goutte de sérum translucide et brillant sur son index, puis le frottent doucement contre sa paume.
​Voix off : (Sons d’ambiance doux de salle de bain / application délicate de la texture du produit)
​00:08 - 00:10
​Visuel : Gros plan sur son visage tandis qu’elle tapote et applique délicatement le sérum sur sa joue, mettant en valeur son teint éclatant et l’application fluide.
​Voix off : "Look how it just melts in..."
​00:10 - 00:13
​Visuel : Plan moyen montrant sa tenue complète — un haut blanc à manches longues et épaules dénudées, un short en cuir marron foncé et des bas blancs montants jusqu’aux cuisses — debout près du plan de travail de la salle de bain avec des plantes et une serviette, touchant doucement sa joue lumineuse.
​Voix off : "...my skin already feels insane."
​00:13 - 00:15
​Visuel : Elle tient à nouveau le flacon de sérum orange, affichant un large sourire éclatant directement à la caméra tout en parlant avec excitation.
​Voix off : "Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"

ja.content:
シネマティックな縦型9:16のビューティーVlogスタイル、4K解像度、超リアルな質感、クリーンなライティング、そして滑らかなカメラスタビライゼーション。  
Scene & Timeline Choreography  
00:00 - 00:02  
Visual: 短いプラチナブロンドの髪と輝くような肌の若い女性が、明るくモダンな白いタイル張りのバスルームの中で、小さな黄色いゴム製のアヒルをあごの下に持ちながら、興奮した表情でカメラをまっすぐ見つめている。  
Voice Over: （遊び心のある、驚いたような息をのむ音、または軽い笑い）  
00:02 - 00:05  
Visual: 彼女は手に持った黄色いゴム製のアヒルを見下ろしながら温かく微笑み、そのあと再びカメラに目を向けて、いたずらっぽい表情を見せる。  
Voice Over: "Okay, wait..."  
00:05 - 00:07  
Visual: 彼女はオレンジ色のスキンケア美容液のボトルをカメラの近くまで持ち上げ、ラベルがはっきり見えるように見せながら、熱意のある表情で話している。  
Voice Over: "I literally cannot believe how good this is."  
00:07 - 00:08  
Visual: 彼女の手元のクローズアップ。透明感のあるツヤのある美容液を指先に1滴出し、手のひらにやさしくなじませている。  
Voice Over: （バスルームの柔らかな環境音／製品のテクスチャーをなじませる穏やかな音）  
00:08 - 00:10  
Visual: 彼女の顔のクローズアップ。美容液を頬にやさしくパッティングしながら塗布し、輝く肌とスムーズな塗り広げを強調している。  
Voice Over: "Look how it just melts in..."  
00:10 - 00:13  
Visual: ミディアムショットで、オフショルダーの白い長袖トップス、ダークブラウンのレザーショーツ、白いサイハイストッキングという全身コーディネートが見える。植物とタオルのあるバスルームのカウンター脇に立ち、輝く頬にそっと触れている。  
Voice Over: "...my skin already feels insane."  
00:13 - 00:15  
Visual: 彼女は再びオレンジ色の美容液ボトルを持ち上げ、興奮した様子で話しながら、カメラに向かって大きく輝く笑顔を見せる。  
Voice Over: "Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"

ko.content:
시네마틱 세로형 9:16 뷰티 vlog 스타일, 4K 해상도, 초현실적인 텍스처, 깔끔한 조명, 부드러운 카메라 안정화.

Scene & Timeline Choreography

00:00 - 00:02  
Visual: 짧은 플래티넘 블론드 헤어와 빛나는 피부 톤을 가진 젊은 여성이 밝고 현대적인 흰색 타일 욕실 안에서 작은 노란색 고무 오리를 턱 아래에 든 채, 들뜬 표정으로 카메라를 सीधे 바라본다.  
Voice Over: (장난스럽고 놀란 듯한 숨 들이마시는 소리 또는 가벼운 웃음)

00:02 - 00:05  
Visual: 그녀는 손에 든 노란색 고무 오리를 내려다보며 따뜻하게 미소 짓다가, 다시 장난스러운 표정으로 카메라를 올려다본다.  
Voice Over: "Okay, wait..."

00:05 - 00:07  
Visual: 그녀가 주황색 스킨케어 세럼 병을 카메라 가까이 들어 올려 라벨이 선명하게 보이도록 보여주며, 열정적인 표정으로 말한다.  
Voice Over: "I literally cannot believe how good this is."

00:07 - 00:08  
Visual: 그녀의 손이 반투명하고 윤기 있는 세럼 한 방울을 손끝에 덜어내고, 그것을 손바닥에 부드럽게 문지르는 클로즈업 샷.  
Voice Over: (욕실의 은은한 주변 소리 / 제품의 부드러운 발림 텍스처)

00:08 - 00:10  
Visual: 그녀가 세럼을 볼에 부드럽게 톡톡 두드리며 바르는 얼굴 클로즈업. 빛나는 피부와 매끄러운 발림이 강조된다.  
Voice Over: "Look how it just melts in..."

00:10 - 00:13  
Visual: 오프숄더 화이트 긴소매 톱, 다크 브라운 레더 쇼츠, 화이트 허벅지까지 오는 스타킹을 입은 전체 의상이 보이는 미디엄 샷. 식물과 수건이 있는 욕실 카운터 옆에 서서, 빛나는 볼을 부드럽게 만진다.  
Voice Over: "...my skin already feels insane."

00:13 - 00:15  
Visual: 그녀가 주황색 세럼 병을 다시 들어 올리고, 카메라를 향해 환하고 빛나는 미소를 지으며 들뜬 목소리로 말한다.  
Voice Over: "Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"

pt.content:
Estilo de vlog de beleza cinematográfico em vertical 9:16, resolução 4k, texturas ultra-realistas, iluminação limpa e estabilização suave da câmera.
​Coreografia de Cena & Linha do Tempo 
​00:00 - 00:02
​Visual: Uma jovem com cabelo curto loiro platinado e pele radiante olha diretamente para a câmera com uma expressão animada dentro de um banheiro branco, moderno e bem iluminado, enquanto segura um pequeno pato de borracha amarelo sob o queixo.
​Voice Over: (Suspiro brincalhão e surpreso ou leve risada)
​00:02 - 00:05
​Visual: Ela sorri calorosamente enquanto olha para baixo para o pato de borracha amarelo em sua mão, depois volta a olhar para a câmera com uma expressão brincalhona.
​Voice Over: "Okay, wait..."
​00:05 - 00:07
​Visual: Ela aproxima um frasco de sérum facial laranja da câmera, exibindo o rótulo com clareza enquanto fala com uma expressão entusiasmada.
​Voice Over: "I literally cannot believe how good this is."
​00:07 - 00:08
​Visual: Um close-up de suas mãos dispensando uma gota do sérum translúcido e brilhante na ponta do dedo e esfregando-o suavemente na palma da mão.
​Voice Over: (Sons ambientes suaves do banheiro / aplicação delicada da textura do produto)
​00:08 - 00:10
​Visual: Close-up do rosto dela enquanto ela dá leves batidinhas e aplica o sérum na bochecha, destacando a pele radiante e a aplicação suave.
​Voice Over: "Look how it just melts in..."
​00:10 - 00:13
​Visual: Plano médio mostrando o look completo — um top branco de manga longa e ombro a ombro, shorts de couro marrom escuro e meias brancas acima da coxa — em pé ao lado da bancada do banheiro com plantas e uma toalha, tocando suavemente a bochecha iluminada.
​Voice Over: "...my skin already feels insane."
​00:13 - 00:15
​Visual: Ela segura o frasco de sérum laranja novamente, abrindo um sorriso amplo e radiante diretamente para a câmera enquanto fala animadamente.
​Voice Over: "Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"

zh.content:
电影感竖屏 9:16 美妆 vlog 风格，4K 分辨率，超写实质感，干净的光线，以及平滑的镜头稳定效果。  
场景与时间线编排  
00:00 - 00:02  
画面：一位留着短款铂金金发、肤色透亮的年轻女性，站在明亮、现代的白色瓷砖浴室里，手里把一只小黄橡皮鸭托在下巴下方，带着兴奋的表情直视镜头。  
旁白：（俏皮、惊讶的吸气声或轻笑）  
00:02 - 00:05  
画面：她低头看着手中的小黄橡皮鸭，温柔地微笑，然后又抬头看向镜头，露出俏皮的表情。  
旁白："Okay, wait..."  
00:05 - 00:07  
画面：她把一瓶橙色护肤精华举到镜头前，清晰展示标签，同时带着热情的表情说话。  
旁白："I literally cannot believe how good this is."  
00:07 - 00:08  
画面：特写她的双手将一滴半透明、光泽感十足的精华挤到指尖上，并轻轻在掌心揉开。  
旁白：（柔和的浴室环境音 / 轻柔的产品质地涂抹声）  
00:08 - 00:10  
画面：她脸部特写，轻轻拍打并将精华涂抹在脸颊上，突出她焕亮的肌肤和顺滑的上妆效果。  
旁白："Look how it just melts in..."  
00:10 - 00:13  
画面：中景展示她的整套穿搭——一件露肩白色长袖上衣、深棕色皮质短裤和白色过膝长袜——她站在浴室台面旁，周围有绿植和毛巾，轻轻触碰自己发光的脸颊。  
旁白："...my skin already feels insane."  
00:13 - 00:15  
画面：她再次举起橙色精华瓶，直接对着镜头绽放灿烂而明亮的笑容，兴奋地说着。  
旁白："Okay, I'm obsessed. I'm not going back!"
